test.name: Spec 0013 full verify rerun: Diagnostics clears the last error after reconnecting

expected: After Stackly reconnects to stacklyd, the Diagnostics Connection section shows Last error None and no What to do hint, and each row's accessibility element carries the current value.
actual: With the fixes ad7779c and b54275d on main 015305a, each Diagnostics row is one accessibility element whose value is `label, value` and follows the screen. Launched with no stacklyd: `Status, stacklyd unavailable`, `Last error, ipc.endpoint_missing …`, `What to do, stacklyd isn’t running…`. After stacklyd started the app connected by itself: `Status, stacklyd degraded` (dev daemon without a catalog), `Last error, None`, no What to do row, `Last connected` and the stacklyd row with the new pid; Copy Details held the same lines. After SIGTERM the rows went back to the error with `(last known)`; after stacklyd started again and Stackly › Reconnect to stacklyd was pressed they cleared again with the new pid. With the socket at 0666 the rows read `stacklyd untrusted`, `ipc.endpoint_untrusted … group_or_other_access`, and the untrusted hint, with zero new daemon log lines; after `chmod 600` and Reconnect in the banner: `Last error, None` and no What to do row.
steps: on commit 015305a with a clean tree: `cargo build -p stacklyd -p stackly-cli -p stackly-fake-server`, `cargo xtask build-app` (Debug), a temporary STACKLY_ROOT under the session scratchpad, and the app started from target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app/Contents/MacOS/Stackly with that root

Claude Code read and pressed elements with a small AXUIElement tool (tree dump, AXPress on buttons and menu items, AXSelected on sidebar rows) and took window screenshots with `screencapture -l`; no keystrokes were sent
`swift test --package-path apps/macos/Packages/StacklyUI --filter "DaemonModelTests|ConnectionDiagnosticsTests|ShellAccessibilityTests"`: 40 tests in 3 suites pass

launch with no stacklyd, select Diagnostics, dump the Connection rows; start stacklyd with the same root, wait 8 s, dump the rows, screenshot, press Copy Details (clipboard saved and restored around the read)
SIGTERM stacklyd, dump the rows, start stacklyd again, press Stackly › Reconnect to stacklyd, dump the rows
quit, `chmod 666` the live socket, launch, dump the rows and count daemon log lines, `chmod 600`, press Reconnect in the banner, dump the rows, screenshot; afterwards quit and stop stacklyd
not covered here: VoiceOver itself (check 6 stays with the user)
reviewer: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) as the checker of the full verify session chk-f13-verify drove the app through the accessibility API and read the screenshots and logs it took; the user has not reviewed this record
